pr.body:
## Why
The manifest advertised UMM 0.28.2 while builds used whatever loader and Harmony DLLs happened to be installed. That did not establish the common 0.31.x baseline requested across the Kingmaker mods.

## Changes
- Set the common minimum to UMM **0.31.1**, matching Tabletop Rules Expansion and Cutscene Skip.
- Compile against SHA-256-verified upstream UMM 0.31.1, Harmony12 1.2.0.1, and Harmony 2.3.1.1 references kept outside the installed game.
- Check the exact references during direct MSBuild as well as the build wrapper.
- Refuse packaging unless the produced DLL references the pinned assembly versions; report reference identities in the build output.
- Document each newer loader as a separate compatibility target and retain historical runtime evidence under its original identity.

## Validation
Passed: PowerShell parsing, real upstream archive/DLL hashes and assembly identities, missing/corrupt Harmony2 rejection, XML/JSON validation, diff checks, and an independent review of the build/package changes. Source inspection found the existing direct Harmony2 finalizer APIs in the pinned baseline binary.

**Not run:** full Kingmaker product compilation, Windows packaging, or in-game compatibility. The game references are not available in this workspace and the Windows game host is offline. This draft is a reviewable source checkpoint, not a release qualification or runtime-support claim. The remaining per-profile checks are in `docs/UMM-COMPATIBILITY.md`.

No gameplay code, save format, installed game, published package, or release was changed.
pr.title: build: establish the UMM 0.31.1 baseline
